Name: AT - Natural Stone Paths
Author: frukei
Description:
Includes 4 colorways for both the stepping stone and cobblestone paths, plus 2 mossy variants per colorway for the cobblestone. It is mildly seasonal, in that moss will go away in winter. I recommend using the spray can to randomize textures. 

Made this a while ago for personal use, because I like the uniformity of the gravelly bits, and it mildly bothered me how the base path looks when going over differing types of terrain.

[s]The stepping stones aren't the [i]best [/i]recolor, but I never ended up uploading before because I told myself I'd adjust it first and never did, so whatever! it lives like this now

[/s]Update: Fixed the stepping stone shadows, and added 6 colors of gravel path! There are 2 variants per color to accommodate for intersections.

now i am content
